body:
> [!CAUTION]
> The consumer version of Gemini Code Assist on GitHub has been sunset. All code review activity has officially ceased.

performed_via_github_app.name: Gemini Code Assist
performed_via_github_app.description:
**Accelerate code reviews and improve code quality**

Bring the power of [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/) directly to GitHub, providing AI-powered code reviews on your pull requests, with automatic pull request summaries, ready-to-commit code suggestions and the ability to invoke Gemini for assistance at any point on the PR.

This app is only available for Google Cloud customers. Follow the [setup instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/code-review/set-up-code-assist-github) to get started.

body:
Independent exact-head review result for `4e2caf24867b1fd09c655a87006ed5dbf1be2ce1`: **changes required**.

The complete recorded baseline passed mechanically: #1714 tests 15/15 and byte-identical rebuild; #1719 tests 12/12 and deterministic six-artifact rebuild; #1716 byte-identical readback; #1719 authenticated readback; focused learning/API/route suites 55/55; targeted ESLint and `git diff --check`; 12 changed files, exactly six semantic artifacts, unchanged #1714/#1716 paths, authenticated hashes, 172/172 approved readbacks, 93/93 candidates omitted from approved reads, and zero unresolved review threads before this comment.

Blocking semantic findings:

1. The implicit-by-parts detector remains too narrow. It recognizes `x` multiplied by exponential/trig/log forms, but misses other standard products. The registry incorrectly approves at least these records as `direct_reverse_chain`: `qrow_9709_m19_qp_32_q04` (`x^(-3/2) ln x`), `qrow_9709_s21_qp_31_q09` (`x^(-2/3) ln x`), `qrow_9709_s23_qp_31_q09` (`x e^(-2x)`), `qrow_9709_w18_qp_32_q03` (`ln x / x^3`), and `qrow_9709_w21_qp_31_q08` (`ln x / sqrt x`). `qrow_9709_w22_qp_33_q03` (`x sec^2 x`) and `qrow_9709_s24_qp_31_q10` (`x tan^-1(2x)`) are approved as merely trigonometric even though integration by parts is the material method. These approved mappings conflict with the shared model applicability claim that no material integration by parts is required.

2. The numeric-only repair now over-approves pure numerical-integration questions. `qrow_9709_s22_qp_22_q04` and `qrow_9709_s22_qp_23_q04` only ask for a trapezium-rule approximation and a graphical under-estimate argument, but both are approved as `direct_reverse_chain` with the rationale that they ask for a symbolic antiderivative/exact integral.

3. `semantic-review-delta.json` is generated directly from the same registry decisions and repeats these incorrect approvals and rationales. On this SHA it therefore does not supply the compact independent semantic approval evidence required by Issue #1719.

Please repair the classification/posture and regenerated artifacts in the same PR, add regression coverage for these examples/classes, and request a fresh exact-head independent review. This verdict is SHA-bound and does not carry forward.

Addressed the second exact-head semantic review in 546a11cae3725d377f4e93ba559a75f50e4d2f8d. The seven cited by-parts classes are now classified as by_parts; the two pure trapezium-only records are rejected; supplied A+B/(...)+C/(...) decompositions are classified as partial_fractions; and semantic-review-delta.json is explicitly a maker delta pending external SHA-bound AO approval. Regenerated metrics are 170 approved, 93 candidate, 21 rejected, with 13/13 semantic tests, 15/15 predecessor tests, 55/55 API/route tests, unchanged #1714/#1716 receipts, and six active artifacts. Requesting a fresh full independent review of this new head.

Independent comprehensive exact-head review for `546a11cae3725d377f4e93ba559a75f50e4d2f8d` (tree `f76b5690251cd2ba8390d2c4a2268c7e301283ef`): **changes required**.

The full recorded mechanical baseline passes: clean exact checkout and expected tree; 12-file/6-artifact scope; unchanged #1714/#1716 paths; #1714 15/15 plus byte identity; #1719 13/13 plus deterministic rebuild; #1716 and #1719 readback checks; focused API/route 55/55; targeted ESLint, artifact-index governance, Python syntax, diff hygiene, manifest hashes, 170 approved/93 candidate isolation, evidence ownership, classification targets/roles, maker-only review-delta posture, and zero unresolved threads before this comment. All specifically cited second-round by-parts rows, both trapezium-only rejections, and both supplied-decomposition rows are repaired.

The every-approved-record audit found a new blocking false-positive introduced by the broadened `has_power_product` rule:

- `qrow_9709_w21_qp_32_q06` proves a product-to-sum identity and integrates `sin 3x cos 2x`; it is currently approved as primary `by_parts`, but the material method is trigonometric identity/product-to-sum, not integration by parts.
- `qrow_9709_s17_qp_31_q10` explicitly uses `u = cos x` to integrate `sin x cos^2 2x`; it is correctly primary `substitution` but now has an incorrect secondary `by_parts` classification.
- `qrow_9709_w23_qp_31_q09` explicitly uses `x = sqrt(u)` (equivalently `u=x^2`) for the area under `x e^(-x^2/4)`; it is correctly primary `substitution` but now has an incorrect secondary `by_parts` classification.

The regex scans broad question text for an `x` token followed by a trig/exponential partner without proving that the product is the integration-by-parts structure or accounting for the explicit substitution. Please remove these false by-parts mappings, tighten the detector/branch interaction, add regression assertions for all three, regenerate the six artifacts/hashes, and request a fresh SHA-bound review. This verdict does not carry forward.

Addressed the third exact-head review finding in `25a09b6794dc00db44e105b2b17ba77bb4fc3c48` (tree `c1df40090b25a80c3e108c1d80e3c79a591750da`). The implicit by-parts detector now excludes `x` tokens that are arguments of preceding trigonometric factors, explicit substitutions no longer inherit incidental by-parts edges, and a positive control preserves the genuine transformed `∫ 2u e^(2u) du` secondary by-parts method. Added regressions for all three cited records plus the positive control and regenerated all six semantic artifacts. Metrics remain 170 approved / 93 candidate / 12 abstain / 21 rejected; method counts are by-parts 18, direct/reverse-chain 71, partial fractions 21, substitution 15, trigonometric 45. Full local gates pass: #1714 15/15 plus byte identity, #1719 13/13 plus deterministic rebuild, #1716/#1719 readbacks, 7 Jest suites 55/55, targeted ESLint, artifact index, syntax/diff hygiene, and unchanged #1714/#1716 authorities. Requesting a fresh comprehensive exact-head review; the prior verdict does not carry forward.

Independent comprehensive exact-head review for `25a09b6794dc00db44e105b2b17ba77bb4fc3c48` (tree `c1df40090b25a80c3e108c1d80e3c79a591750da`): **PASS**.

The complete recorded baseline passed from a new fully materialized clean detached checkout: exact SHA/tree; 12 changed files and exactly six active artifacts; unchanged #1714/#1716 predecessor bytes; #1714 tests 15/15 plus byte-identical rebuild; #1719 tests 13/13 plus deterministic six-artifact rebuild; #1716 and #1719 authenticated readbacks; 7 focused Jest suites 55/55; targeted ESLint; artifact-index governance; in-memory Python syntax; diff hygiene; and manifest byte-length/SHA-256 authentication.

The comprehensive semantic audit reviewed every one of the 170 approved records against its bound source text across all five method families. The independent 296-record integrity audit passed evidence ownership, exact classification targets/roles, 170 approved versus 93 candidate isolation, maker-only review-delta posture, and five shared ProcedureModels with 15 ordered ProcedureSteps. Explicit repair checks pass: `w21/32/q06` is trigonometric product-to-sum only; `s17/31/q10` and `w23/31/q09` are substitution without spurious by-parts; positive control `s23/33/q07` is substitution with a genuine transformed by-parts secondary.

The PR head has not drifted and all eight review threads are resolved. At verdict time ten GitHub jobs were queued and one trust-boundary job was skipped; Issue #1719 explicitly treats infrastructure-only queued/cancelled states as non-blocking. This SHA-bound review clears the independent AO gate only and does not grant merge authority.
